voice_rules: Ryan's voice: tight, direct, no filler, no em dashes, no exclamation marks, no 'hope this finds you well'. Facts and math over adjectives.

touches.subject: cameras inside the {brand_installed} track
touches.body:
{first_name}, you have {brand_installed} on {homes_estimate} homes around {city}. Every one of those rooflines can carry a camera nobody can see from the street: dual-sensor nodes that live inside the track, deter with the lights themselves, and produce verified events police actually respond to.

For {company} that is a $1,299 to $1,799 ticket (est.) on installs you already sold, at dealer margin, with no new trades: it is all Class 2.

Worth 20 minutes? I will show you a live break-in scenario end to end and run a real quote on one of your past installs.

{first_name}, sent you a note about putting cameras inside the {brand_installed} tracks you install. The short version: the roofline you already own is the best camera real estate on the house, and nobody is selling it. 20 minutes and I will demo the 2:14 AM scenario live.

touches.subject: the math for {company}
touches.body:
{first_name}, last one from me. The math I would want if I ran {company}:

- attach one SightLine kit to half your installs: 20+ tickets a year at $500+ dealer margin each (est.)
- recurring share on the $9.99/$19.99 plans (est. 30%)
- install adds under 2 hours on a track you are already on
- the scan-to-quote agent prices the kit in 5 minutes, off your existing measurements

If the answer is no, tell me and I am gone. If it is maybe, 20 minutes: reply with a day that works in {city} time.
